anomalies.title: Anomalies
anomalies.intro: Books that look a little too much alike: same file name, same title, or the same file copied elsewhere.
anomalies.empty: No anomaly found: the library is clean.
anomalies.sameName.hint: These files share a name in different folders.
anomalies.sameTitle.hint: These books share a title, ignoring accents and case.
anomalies.sameContent.hint: Same size, format and page count: the same file at another path.
anomalies.format.unsupported.hint: The application cannot open these formats.
anomalies.format.unopenable.hint: The format is recognised, but the file could not be opened (damaged archive, truncated PDF…).
anomalies.format.ok: Every file has a supported format and opens correctly.

home.title: My library
search.label: Filter the library
home.emptyBefore: No books yet: drop an EPUB, a CBZ or a PDF into
home.emptyAfter: — it will show up here without reloading the page.
folder.createAtRoot: It will be created at the root of the library.
help.title: Adding books
help.drop: Drag and drop files, or a whole folder, anywhere on the page: they are added to the folder shown, keeping their tree.
help.offline: Only EPUB, CBZ, CBR and PDF are taken. An existing name is never overwritten.
card.noPages: Page count unknown: this book cannot be marked as read
reader.unsupportedNote: This format cannot be opened for now.

perf.title: Performance
perf.subtitle: Memory and CPU of the application, measured live (every {seconds} s).
perf.unsupported: Detailed measurements are only available on Linux.
perf.range.label: Period
perf.range.liveHint: Updated every {seconds} s; the last 3 minutes stay in the browser.
perf.history.empty: No measurements recorded for this period.
perf.history.hint: Recorded every {sample} s, kept for {days} days.
perf.ram.hint: Container value, close to what Docker shows: it includes the file cache, which the system reclaims as soon as space runs short.
perf.ram.compositionHint: Programs keep their memory; the file cache is reclaimed by the system when needed.
perf.detail.title: What the API keeps
perf.detail.hint: Heap = the API’s data in memory, excluding stacks and mapped files. The peak keeps the highest value reached; Argon2 explains the spike when someone signs in.
perf.auth.title: Authentication cost
perf.auth.share: Share of the API’s CPU time
perf.auth.hint: Counters accumulated since start; the share compares time spent checking sessions with the API’s total CPU time.
perf.reading.title: Reads in progress
perf.reading.released: Returned to the system since startup
perf.reading.media: of which media cache (nginx), already returned
perf.reading.mediaLimit: Capped at 64 MB (max_size in docker/nginx.conf): beyond that, nginx drops the least recently served pages, which also frees their memory pages. The total therefore stops growing once the cache is full.
perf.reading.hint: Memory = the part of the book held in the file cache. After {seconds} s without a request the reading is over and this cache is returned to the system right away, without waiting for space to run short.
perf.storage.subtitle: What the application occupies on disk: books, covers, databases and code.
perf.storage.diskHint: The application and the books share the disk without overlapping.
perf.storage.breakdownHint: Code: API binary and UI build. Data: databases, covers and page counts.
perf.storage.libraryHint: Size of the book files; {known} of {total} books have their pages counted.
perf.storage.coversHint: JPEG thumbnails generated on demand, at most {budget} kept in memory.
perf.storage.pageCacheHint: On-disk cache of page counts, read back at startup; past the cap, the oldest are dropped.
perf.storage.databasesHint: SQLite in WAL mode: the journal absorbs writes and starts over at each checkpoint.
perf.storage.appHint: Footprint of the program and the compiled interface, data excluded.
perf.storage.largestHint: The rest of the library weighs {rest}.
stats.title: Library statistics
stats.subtitle: What the library holds: totals, formats, folders and biggest books.
stats.booksHint: Files found in the books folder.
stats.weightHint: Sum of the book files, covers and databases excluded.
stats.allCounted: Every book has its page count.

stats.missingUnreadable.one: {count} book has no page count ({unreadable} in CBR, which the server cannot open)
stats.missingUnreadable.other: {count} books have no page count ({unreadable} in CBR, which the server cannot open)

stats.formatsHint: What each format weighs and the pages it brings; a format the server cannot open has no pages.
stats.drillHint: Click a slice of the pie to see the folders it holds.

auth.error.email_required: The provider must supply a verified e-mail address to create an account.
users.sessions.hint: A session stays valid until it expires, even if the person closed their browser. “Online” means a tab is open right now; “Recently active”, that it reported in less than two minutes ago (frozen tab or sleeping machine).
